single: Edit ONLY the color treatment of the first input image, a finished flat horizontal rhythm-game RELEASE sprite. Input 1 is the edit target; input 2 is the POINT sprite and provides the palette reference; input 3 is the BODY sprite and provides the shadow palette reference. Preserve the exact 5:1 rectangular silhouette, every internal edge, diagonal junction, panel proportion, thin highlight position, and symmetric geometry of input 1. Do not redesign or add ornament. This is a subtle precise palette harmonization, NOT a new illustration. Replace the very saturated neon CYAN highlights with the pale icy SKY BLUE/near-white highlights of input 2. Harmonize the blue midtones with input 2's cool blue metal trim and the dark blue shadows of input 3. Keep the release medium-brightness so the point remains the brightest broad surface. Retain the original smooth broad shading, fine crisp outline and readable junctions. Reduce the cyan cast without making the result gray or dull, no increased depth or thickness, no added bevels or glow. NO icons, NO arrows, NO text. Output only the recolored sprite, straight front orthographic view, isolated on actual transparent background, comfortably inside canvas, at maximum useful resolution. Keep the entire rectangular body opaque all the way to the four corners; transparency is only outside the rectangular sprite. Do not include the reference point or body in output.
